parameters.jsCode:
const failClosed = {
  executionResult: 'fail_closed',
  mode: 'dry-run',
  mutationsPerformed: false,
  state: 'FAIL_CLOSED',
  requestedProvider: 'gemini',
  lastProvider: $json.llmAttempt?.provider || null,
  lastModel: $json.llmAttempt?.model || null,
  repairUsed: Boolean($json.repairUsed),
  fallbackUsed: Boolean($json.fallbackUsed),
  attemptCount: ($json.aiObservability || []).length,
  failureReason: $json.failureReason || null,
  attempts: $json.aiObservability || [],
  stateHistory: $json.stateHistory || [],
};
throw new Error(`FAIL_CLOSED: ${JSON.stringify(failClosed)}`);

const failValidator = {
  executionResult: 'fail_validator',
  mode: 'dry-run',
  mutationsPerformed: false,
  state: 'FAIL_VALIDATOR',
  requestedProvider: 'gemini',
  lastProvider: $json.llmAttempt?.provider || null,
  lastModel: $json.llmAttempt?.model || null,
  repairUsed: Boolean($json.repairUsed),
  fallbackUsed: Boolean($json.fallbackUsed),
  attemptCount: ($json.aiObservability || []).length,
  failureReason: $json.failureReason || null,
  attempts: $json.aiObservability || [],
  stateHistory: $json.stateHistory || [],
};
throw new Error(`FAIL_VALIDATOR: ${JSON.stringify(failValidator)}`);

const data = $json;
const preview = data.plan.issues.map((issue, index) => ({
  order: index + 1,
  key: issue.key,
  title: issue.title,
  assignee: issue.assignee,
  category: issue.category,
  difficulty: issue.difficulty,
  weight: issue.estimatedWeight,
  functionalWeight: issue.functionalWeight,
  operationalWeight: issue.operationalWeight,
  risk: issue.risk,
  requiresCoding: issue.requiresCoding,
  requiresRepositoryKnowledge: issue.requiresRepositoryKnowledge,
  requirementKind: issue.requirementKind,
  groundingStatus: issue.groundingStatus,
  provenance: issue.provenance,
  labels: [data.course, `week-${data.weekPadded}`, `type:${issue.type}`, `priority:${issue.priority}`],
  dependsOn: issue.dependsOn,
  body: `${issue.body.trim()}\n\n<!-- automation:classroom -->\n<!-- classroom-course-id:${data.courseId} -->\n<!-- classroom-coursework-id:${data.courseWorkId} -->\n<!-- classroom-update-time:${data.updateTime} -->\n<!-- course:${data.course} -->\n<!-- week:${data.weekPadded} -->\n<!-- issue-key:${issue.key} -->\n<!-- starter:${data.starter?.name || 'none'} -->\n<!-- plan-keys:${data.planKeys.join(',')} -->`,
}));
return [{
  json: {
    mode: 'dry-run',
    mutationsPerformed: false,
    aiExecution: data.aiExecution,
    aiObservability: data.aiObservability,
    stateHistory: data.stateHistory,
    courseId: data.courseId,
    courseWorkId: data.courseWorkId,
    updateTime: data.updateTime,
    starter: { found: data.starter?.found, name: data.starter?.name || null, fileCount: data.starter?.fileCount || 0 },
    course: data.course,
    week: data.week,
    repository: data.repository,
    assignmentTitle: data.plan.assignmentTitle,
    deadline: data.plan.deadline,
    assignmentPolicy: data.assignmentPolicy,
    gapAnalysis: data.gapAnalysis,
    groundingReport: data.groundingReport,
    missingLabelsThatWouldBeCreated: data.missingLabels,
    issuesThatWouldBeCreated: preview,
    note: 'No se crearon Issues ni labels; Classroom y Drive se consultaron en modo de sólo lectura.',
  },
}];
return [{ json: $('Plan and Topological Sort').item.json }];
